critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1273 lines — split recommended into routers (auth/users, register_pos, attendance, payroll, inventory, reports) before next iteration to stay under 700-line target.

compute_pay() treats attendance with no explicit 'status' as approved via a.get('status','approved')=='approved' — correct because only lembur gets 'pending' set; still, consider explicit filter `a.get('type')=='lembur'` already applied so OK.
register_handover updates sess['shifts'] in-place then $set — fine but non-atomic between two tablets. For single shared tablet (per spec) OK; multi-tablet would need an aggregation-pipeline update.

pos_close computes expected_cash = opening_cash + Cash by_method; non-Cash methods aren't expected in till — correct. Consider also returning per-shift cash expectation for the 'close-shift-N cards & expected cash' UI (close sheet already renders this client-side).
verify_pin raises 400 for missing PIN with employee name in message — nice UX, used by both /register/handover and /attendance/kiosk.
attendance_live computes hours live for still-clocked-in users (end=now()); timezone-aware (Asia/Jakarta). Confirmed shift_start returned per row for 'live attendance' display.
Still using FastAPI @app.on_event (deprecated) — migrate to lifespan (noted in iter2).
